description: The LKKA annual meeting is retained as a pending lead because LSM announced it for Feb. 22 and a search-only LETA/TV3 result later says it occurred and most members supported a conditional Pavļuts resignation demand. The opened LSM article does not establish meeting attendance, venue, mode, public access, result or a protest action. The reported 9,000 registered providers are not meeting participants.
required_followup: If a review continues, seek an accessible contemporaneous account establishing the meeting’s venue/mode, public status, attendance, and whether a separate public action occurred. Keep the candidate pending until evidence addresses gathering status and the 50-person threshold.

description: AFP describes haircuts in forests and on frozen lakes as protest, including one client at a time, but no collective gathering, attendance or activity start is established. Other captured reports describe individual haircut or advocacy actions.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous account of any coordinated public gathering, its actual start date, location and concurrent attendance; do not infer a single event from dispersed services.

description: Body retrieval did not succeed for three potentially relevant sources. S003 web.open returned Cache miss and one exact-URL curl failed DNS; S009 web.open returned Cache miss and one exact-URL curl failed DNS; S013 web.open returned UnexpectedStatusCode without exposing an HTTP code/body and a separately gated curl failed DNS (HTTP 000). These are technical failures, not observed denials.
required_followup: Leave sources search_only. Do not retry or use another URL without a new exact-URL receipt, full manual publisher/origin note, and immediate corpus-hash check.

description: This bounded open-web pass logged 12 actual batched search actions and 284 ordered result headers, using English and Latvian general, weekly, geographic and sector-specific queries. It did not provide systematic access to LexisNexis, complete local/regional archives, or every municipal/event notice. No qualifying event is established by this corpus; that is not evidence that none occurred.
required_followup: A reviewer may extend local and regional archive searches if warranted; do not report the first-pass search as exhaustive.
